inspection_depth: Scope and selected primary introduction/theorem statements; no full proof audit, Lean rebuild or Comparator run. Source pins are not a current literature-status verification.

edges.scope: Weighted dilation graphs Theorem 1.1: infinitely many totient values v with multiplicity >v^(1-epsilon), for every epsilon>0; full atlas multiplicity-exponent question.
missing_hypotheses: Independent proof audit; no Lean scope supplied for F011.

edges.scope: Ostmann Theorem 1.1 excludes any finite symmetric difference between primes and A+B with both summands having at least two elements; in particular excludes the atlas two-infinite-summands decomposition.
missing_hypotheses: External proof/Lean dependency audit.

edges.scope: Theorem 2.1: explicit asymptotic for number V(x) of distinct totients and V(cx)/V(x)->c for every fixed c>0, including c=2.
missing_hypotheses: External proof/Lean dependency audit.

edges.scope: Corollary 1.2 and selected Lean scope: positive lower density of indices n with p_n/n<p_(n+1)/(n+1).
missing_hypotheses: External proof/Lean dependency audit.

edges.scope: A strict gap from one: liminf V(x)/Vprime(x)>1, where Vprime counts distinct phi(m), m<=x. Not limit existence.
missing_hypotheses: F024 Theorem 2.2; independent review of this short deduction.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: N1(x) counts totients <=x with least preimage in (x,2x]. Theorem 2.2 gives N1(x)>=cV(x) eventually for some 0<c<1. Since N1<=V-Vprime, V/Vprime>=1/(1-c).

edges.scope: Existence of a limit of V/Vprime is not supplied by regular variation or the individual companion counts.
missing_hypotheses: Control of all least-preimage tails; convergence or cancellation of phase dependence in coefficient ratios.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: V uses a positive phase-dependent arithmetic coefficient. Fixed k counts alone do not justify an infinite sum or a limiting ratio.

edges.scope: Unbounded least-preimage ratio is explicitly left unresolved by F024.
missing_hypotheses: Totient seeds d with least_preimage(d)/d arbitrarily large.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: F024 Theorem 2.2 is conditional on such a seed for each k; positivity is only asserted automatically for k=1,2.

edges.scope: Large fibers do not imply large least-preimage ratios.
missing_hypotheses: Control of the minimum preimage, rather than only fiber cardinality.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: P821 and P51 share A014197, but even many preimages can coexist with one small preimage.

edges.scope: Distinct-value asymptotics do not force equal totients at consecutive arguments.
missing_hypotheses: Shifted equality correlation phi(n)=phi(n+1).

edges.scope: Improved reservoir of smooth prime predecessors may strengthen Carmichael constructions.
missing_hypotheses: Primes in required progressions; subset-product congruence extraction; exact 64-factor witness and minimality for current finite cell.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: The F011 introduction itself identifies smooth predecessors as an ingredient in Carmichael construction, separate from progression-distribution input.

edges.scope: Weighted dilation graphs compare integer divisibility samples with independent prime-label operators using CRT memories and signed high moments.
missing_hypotheses: Prime-square moduli; actual squarefree variance weight; required growing scales; summable endpoint and tail losses.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: Inspect Sections 3 and ideal-kernel hypotheses before attempting to transfer the comparison mechanism.

edges.scope: Joint Dickman law for fixed smoothness exponents at n,n+1 in ordinary natural density.
missing_hypotheses: External proof/Lean dependency audit.

edges.scope: Each strict ordering of consecutive largest prime factors has density one half.
missing_hypotheses: External proof/Lean dependency audit.

edges.scope: Strengthens already-solved infinitude of simultaneous square-root-smooth neighbors to density rho(2)^2=(1-log 2)^2.
missing_hypotheses: F012 joint law; strict/non-strict threshold boundary has density zero.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: Take a=b=1/2; equality n=p^2 contributes O(sqrt X), and analogous n+1 equality has density zero.

edges.scope: For k=2 and every fixed epsilon>0, a positive proportion of pairs in each sufficiently large dyadic interval are n^epsilon-smooth; does not provide k>=3.
missing_hypotheses: F012 at fixed smaller exponent; extension to k-point laws for longer runs.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: Choose 0<a<min(epsilon,1); the count on (X/2,X] is (rho(1/a)^2/2+o(1))X by subtracting prefix asymptotics. Their prime factors are <=X^epsilon eventually.

edges.scope: Joint law of consecutive square-product waiting times: dens{t_n<=n^a, t_(n+1)<=(n+1)^b}=rho(1/a)rho(1/b), 0<a,b<1.
missing_hypotheses: F012 joint law; BPZ24 Theorem 1.1 marginal law; independent review of density-zero transfer.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: Largest-prime-square exceptions have density zero. Outside them P+(n)<=t_n. Equal marginal densities imply threshold-event symmetric difference o(X); replacing both events in the joint law costs o(X). Full derivation in number-theory.md.

edges.scope: Fixed positive-power smoothness law does not imply the logarithmic-scale smoothness conjecture for n(n+1).
missing_hypotheses: Uniformity when a(X) is of size log log X/log X; a lower-envelope theorem for every n.

edges.scope: Two-coordinate laws do not determine three consecutive largest-prime-factor orderings.
missing_hypotheses: A three-point joint law or separate ordering argument.

edges.scope: Positive-density power-smooth pairs do not bound the longest run for a fixed smoothness threshold.
missing_hypotheses: Moving exponents log B/log X; arbitrary run length; exact extremal exclusion.

edges.scope: Density information does not remove the atlas sparse positional counterexample candidates.
missing_hypotheses: Conditional law on actual smooth-part divisibilities or direct obstruction to positional equations.

edges.scope: h(k)<=C k^2/(log log(3k))^2 answers the quadratic subquestion, but not the full order of magnitude.
missing_hypotheses: External proof/Lean dependency audit; full matching lower bound for order question.

edges.scope: Primorial maximum coprime gap is O(z^2/((log z)^2(log log z)^2)).
missing_hypotheses: F021 and prime number theorem; no explicit constant or finite next cell.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: Set k=pi(z) and use h(k) for the product of primes <=z.

edges.scope: Least missing even gap a(k)<=h(k)+2 for the first-k-prime primorial.
missing_hypotheses: F021; numerical constants for a finite table improvement.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: Every coprime gap is even and <=h(k), so the next even integer above h(k) is absent.

edges.scope: For fixed r>=1, sum of rth powers of consecutive reduced-residue gaps <= h(omega(m))^(r-1)*m. A coarse consequence; known sharper theorem already solves P220.
missing_hypotheses: F021; no novelty claim versus Montgomery-Vaughan bounds.

edges.scope: A guaranteed coprime integer per interval does not prove a system of distinct representatives.
missing_hypotheses: Hall conditions or another matching theorem compatible with overlaps.

edges.scope: Worst minimum Egyptian length at denominator b is Theta(log log b); finite row-106 maximum is not evaluated.
missing_hypotheses: External proof/Lean dependency audit; effective constants and exact enumeration for current finite cell.

edges.scope: Least absent prescribed denominator v(k) has log log v(k)=Theta(k), with explicit asymptotic slopes; not an exact formula or limiting slope.
missing_hypotheses: External proof/Lean dependency audit; exact values/limit if desired.

edges.scope: O(log log b) terms for general rationals does not imply a three-term expansion of 4/n.
missing_hypotheses: Exactly three terms for specified numerator four.

edges.scope: Preserving a specified denominator does not ensure it is the least denominator.
missing_hypotheses: All denominators >=N and sharp linear length overhead.

edges.scope: Unrestricted short expansions do not impose distinct-semiprime denominators.
missing_hypotheses: Denominator factorization restriction.

edges.scope: Short expansions do not force two-term forbidden relations inside a fixed set.
missing_hypotheses: Activated forbidden pair inside the same set or a cross-fiber deficit.

edges.scope: Prime-factor splitting and factorial-divisor representations may furnish test distributions for smooth-fiber optimization.
missing_hypotheses: An inequality for the actual forbidden-pair operator; multiplier compatibility; boundary loss control.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: The shared object is smooth divisor support, not the Egyptian-fraction conclusion itself.

edges.scope: Positive lower density beyond every fixed gap threshold does not give every finite value as a normalized-gap limit point.
missing_hypotheses: Control of gaps in arbitrarily small intervals around each prescribed normalized size.

edges.scope: Lower tail density alone does not establish the exact second-moment asymptotic.
missing_hypotheses: Quantitative tail law and uniform integrability/upper tails.

edges.scope: Positive-density increases of p_n/n do not decide convergence of the alternating series sum (-1)^n n/p_n.
missing_hypotheses: Signed parity cancellation or summable variation.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: The fact that monotonicity fails on positive density is not a convergence or divergence test.

edges.scope: For every fixed positive prime q, infinitely many larger primes p have q as primitive root; quantitative dyadic lower bound c_q x/(log x)^2.
missing_hypotheses: F029 Theorem 1.1 audit; full P985 requires every modulus p rather than infinitely many.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: Set the admissible base a=q; eventually p>q. This is a quantified subcase, not the universal modulus assertion.

edges.scope: A fixed-base infinitude theorem does not ensure every prime modulus has a small prime primitive root.
missing_hypotheses: Uniform coverage of all moduli; interchange of fixed-base and every-modulus quantifiers.

edges.scope: Polynomial power-free density does not supply moving-interval squarefree variance or quarter-power error.
missing_hypotheses: Correct one-variable sequence, interval uniformity, quantitative signed moment saving.

edges.scope: Squarefree values of one irreducible quartic do not control squarefree values of all pairwise sums in an extremal set.
missing_hypotheses: Uniform simultaneous two-variable constraints and extremal cardinality estimates.

edges.scope: Large-prime-power tail estimates and number-field factorization may help divisor sums along irreducible polynomials.
missing_hypotheses: Weighted divisor counts and all divisor-size ranges; squarefree density alone has no control of tau(f(n)).

edges.scope: Weak inhomogeneous metric approximation extends the setting of the already-solved homogeneous Duffin-Schaeffer problem.
missing_hypotheses: Numerators in F022 are unrestricted; it is not a new proof of the coprime homogeneous equivalence.

edges.scope: Adaptive partitions and weighted least-common-multiple second-moment control may help arithmetic sample versus product-model comparisons.
missing_hypotheses: Transfer of concrete kernel and weight hypotheses; prime-square structure; growing interval regime.

edges.scope: A fixed-mode first moment over Eisenstein primes does not imply the required weighted Mobius square-frequency second moment.
missing_hypotheses: Different coefficient sequence and domain; second-moment estimate; uniformity in modes/masks.

edges.scope: Irrationality exponent of pi gives no irrationality conclusion for sum 1/(n!-1).
missing_hypotheses: A representation or independently proved approximation construction for the actual target constant.

edges.scope: Correctly unobstructed parts.ii: infinitely many (d-2)-power-free values for irreducible integer polynomials of degree d>3. F020 gives positive Euler-product density and also covers power-of-two degrees excluded by that atlas variant.
missing_hypotheses: External theorem and formal dependency audit; exact local condition is no fixed prime (d-2)th power divisor.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: Do not use the stub answer False for the separate allow_fixed_divisors variant as the status of parts.ii.

edges.scope: Part.iii: n^4+2 is squarefree for a positive density of n, hence infinitely often.
missing_hypotheses: F020 quartic theorem; independent review or formalization of the specialization.
edges.derivation_or_obstruction: x^4+2 is Eisenstein at 2. Values at 0 and 1 are 2 and 3, so no prime square divides every value. The F020 positive-density squarefree theorem applies.

edges.scope: No infinite injective bounded-step Gaussian-prime walk; scope states uniformly finite components for every fixed step bound.
missing_hypotheses: External proof/Lean dependency audit; no explicit numerical component bound.
